newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Nov 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Banking sector shares were most active in trading on the Saudi stock market on Monday.
- Investment in local production of automobile spare parts reached two billion riyals last year.
- Crown Prince Abdullah will lay the foundation stone of a major power station. The station costs 6,491 million riyals and will have a production capacity of 1,286 megawatts.
- Al-Masafi Saudi Company net profits were 6.5 million riyals in the first half of its financial year. REUTERS
